purpose: One click-to-edit text field row on a card: it shows the value (or nothing, in view mode, when empty), turns into an input on a click in edit mode, commits on Enter or on leaving, reverts on Escape, and does not treat a click into an open dialog or popover as leaving.
namedChanges: the imports are the peers' (`useCardMode` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-card-mode`; `insideOpenLayer` and `modalIsOpen` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-open-popups`; in the source they were `../records/cardMode`, `../records/planLeave` and `../ui/layers`);

the picker branches are cut, because the Plan cards use only the text branch. ( … )`, the picker branch `editing && picker ? ( … )`, and the head `) : editing ? (` of the text chain, which now starts as `{editing ? (`); at line 322 `pickedDisplay(picker, value)` is `value`. Nothing the text, choice or textarea branches run through is changed;
